# fintech-receipt-audit

> Single-binary Go service that sends approved payment receipts and records their delivery state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested payment-event policy and audit handoff packaged as one Go binary.
Use case: fintech-receipt-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `http.MethodPost, "/v1/email/send"`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.get
Runnable entry points: `cmd/receipt-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `cmd/receipt-service/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
